title: Today's top defense-tech headlines
big: 36 new stories since the last brief. The busiest areas: drones & air autonomy and allies & theaters.

stories.h: Germany changes course on plans to buy MQ-28 drone wingman: Boeing official
stories.what: Germany has set a target of 2029 to field a CCA, which would make it the first European country to reach such a milestone, but that timeline now looks to be in doubt.
stories.you: Drones are becoming the military's default purchase, so volume, price and reliability decide who wins.

stories.h: Order to limit Starshield for Ukraine came from inside White House, sources say
stories.what: The order to limit a satellite system used by Ukraine for battlefield communications and drone operations came from inside the White House.
stories.you: More of the military's sensing and communications now runs through orbit, and new suppliers are getting in.

stories.h: Canada’s Calian wins $33M deal to script NATO war games
stories.what: Canadian defense contractor Calian Group has won a five-year contract worth about CA$47 million ($33.2 million) to keep writing the scenarios behind NATO’s major command exercises at the alliance’s Joint Warfare Centre in Stavanger, Norway.
stories.you: Allies' wars and budgets are the testing ground and a big second market for new defense tech.

stories.h: Britain’s new Challenger 3 tank passes 2,000 km in trials
stories.what: The British Army’s new Challenger 3 tank has now driven 2,000 km (1,240 miles) and fired more than 200 main gun rounds in testing, and it is set to start a tougher phase of trials in November, according to its builder, Rheinmetall BAE Systems Land.
stories.you: Ground robots are moving from demos to real orders, starting with logistics and dangerous jobs.

stories.h: Q A: No Longer a Software Factory, What’s Next for Air Force’s Kessel Run?
stories.what: Almost a decade ago, the Air Force created Kessel Run in 2017 as a military-commercial partnership and Airmen-led “software factory” in response to the service’s troubled rollout of the Air Operations Center 10.2. New leader Col.
stories.you: Software that decides what to look at and what to hit is where the most value is moving.

watch.why: Around November 3. Whether US commercial growth keeps outpacing government revenue.

idea.h: Tactical power and thermal systems for directed energy
idea.why: Batteries, power conditioning and cooling packs that let lasers and microwave weapons fire continuously on vehicles. Laser production has started (AeroVironment E-HEL) but fielding is slow (Iron Beam); power and cooling are the constraint.
